title: Glowing sushi roll
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <radialGradient id='glow' cx='50%' cy='50%' r='50%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#fff2b0' stop-opacity='0.55'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#fff2b0' stop-opacity='0'/>
    </radialGradient>
  </defs>
  <circle cx='50' cy='52' r='46' fill='url(#glow)'/>
  <!-- nori outer ring -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='52' r='34' fill='#2f7d54'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='52' r='34' fill='none' stroke='#4fbe86' stroke-width='3'/>
  <!-- rice ring -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='52' r='27' fill='#f4f0e2'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='52' r='27' fill='none' stroke='#fffdf5' stroke-width='2'/>
  <!-- rice grains -->
  <ellipse cx='34' cy='38' rx='4' ry='2.2' fill='#dcd6c4' transform='rotate(-30 34 38)'/>
  <ellipse cx='62' cy='36' rx='4' ry='2.2' fill='#dcd6c4' transform='rotate(20 62 36)'/>
  <ellipse cx='30' cy='60' rx='4' ry='2.2' fill='#dcd6c4' transform='rotate(60 30 60)'/>

  <ellipse cx='50' cy='74' rx='4' ry='2.2' fill='#dcd6c4' transform='rotate(-8 50 74)'/>
  <!-- salmon filling -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='52' r='18' fill='#ff8b5e'/>
  <circle cx='50' cy='52' r='18' fill='none' stroke='#ffb894' stroke-width='2.5'/>
  <path d='M40 46 Q50 42 60 46' stroke='#ffd0b8' stroke-width='2' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M38 54 Q50 50 62 54' stroke='#ffd0b8' stroke-width='2' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M40 62 Q50 58 60 62' stroke='#ffd0b8' stroke-width='2' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- avocado dab -->
  <circle cx='58' cy='45' r='6' fill='#9fd45a'/>
  <circle cx='58' cy='45' r='6' fill='none' stroke='#c8ef8e' stroke-width='1.5'/>

  <circle cx='42' cy='58' r='5' fill='#5fc9a8'/>
  <circle cx='42' cy='58' r='5' fill='none' stroke='#a0ebd4' stroke-width='1.5'/>

  <g fill='#fff6c8'>

    <path d='M78 76 l1.5 4 4 1.5 -4 1.5 -1.5 4 -1.5 -4 -4 -1.5 4 -1.5z'/>
    <path d='M22 78 l1.5 4 4 1.5 -4 1.5 -1.5 4 -1.5 -4 -4 -1.5 4 -1.5z'/>
